report.answer_text: Cardinal Robert Francis Prevost was elected pope on May 8, 2025, and took the name Pope Leo XIV. He is the first pope from the United States. He succeeded Pope Francis, who died in April 2025. Before his election, Prevost had served as a missionary in Peru and led the Dicastery for Bishops in the Vatican.
